newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated Dec 25.
-- Employers federation and trade unions agree to guarantee complementary pension scheme for retirements at age 60 through to 2001 as government commits 700 million francs to scheme for 1997-2000.
-- Three paradoxes characterise the 1996 French economy. Cash-strapped consumers are spending, companies with big plans are not investing and yet the stock market has surged ahead.
-- Christmas sales up two percent -- best season since 1990.
